caption: Kar. 103. Altar
reading: wisi : sore(2)yi : te(3)ndḫr(4)qowi : pestoli : (5)terikelo(6)wi : ñb(7)eyros mi : (8)tedḫl?owi : (9)dsek(10)e : mstowi : slẖ(11)s : mnptowi : atomẖe : (12)psoẖte : at (13): mẖe : psi(14)ḫr :
notes: Plain closed 3 read s, 3 with tail read m (as in atomẖe/mẖe, where the tailed 3 must be m and the plain one ẖ); this m/s/ẖ split is uncertain throughout. 'ywi' ending of the name group (line 4): the sign before // is a curled 3, s or m. Line 8: tedḫ?owi has only one S-like sign between ḫ and o, read l (could be e). 'psi(14)ḫr': the sign after s is drawn as a 4 crossed by the 3 (could be o with a ligature stroke). 'psom?te': slash then 3, read s+o (not q). Line 3 initial sign k (3 with long tail to lower right), could be p. Initial sign of line 7 group is an X: ñ or d. 'msto wi' (line 10): no clear gap, written as seen. Text ends at the copy edge with 'psiḫr :' (no -kete).
check_notes: Names table A/B/C, Indexes A-C and formulae A, B all placed. Name A tendḫrqowi: the long-tailed 3 after te is n, the curled 3 plus slash before wi is q + o. B: ñbeyrosmi, copy leaves a gap before mi (kept). C pestoli: the long-tailed sign I took for a (S2) is p followed by e. 3-shaped signs: slẖs and psoẖte show the tailed 3 as ẖ; in atomẖe the order m, ẖ stays. Index B/C pesetoli and Index C pstoli kept at pestoli (copy has a plain 3, no se; and has e). tedḫl?owi has no entry and stays.

caption: Kar. 104. Fragment of Altar on Pl. 28
notes: Fragment: lines 6-8 not copied; line 4 begins at a bracket-like edge stroke after a (S2). Griffith puts a small '?' over the o in line 4. 'ste' (/ϟ after 3) could be s+lo. In 'delotokwi' the U-shaped sign is read to (no dot). Line 9 first sign hatched, 3-shaped. The V-sign in psosebkete and psiḫrbke read b. 'atmẖe': t has no visible dot. Line 12 te stands apart 'in field'.
check_notes: Index A deke : mlo : mdetebkwi fits line 4-5 sign for sign; Griffith's own ? over k kept (the copy's slash under that ? is part of the k, not an o). Index B gives the heading form mdetowi by ditto, not this text's spelling. Formula A: the hatched sign before p is e (end of mẖe); the second s is ẖ. Names table: 'lost' (nothing to place).

caption: Kar. 105. Altar
reading: wosi : (2)soreyi : skl : (3)diyeqowi : mese(4)n : mnitowi : medo : mnptowi (5)slẖ : mnptowi : (6)mseye : te(7)rike(8)lowi : qo(9)w?oli : te(10)dḫlowi : (11)ato : mẖe psiẖte atmẖe (12)psiḫrkte : (13)ḫmlo ẖl(14)kte :
notes: Line 1 of soreyi: i drawn as a 4 with an extra stroke. Line 3 r is a w-shape with an extra tick (same sign as r in line 7). n? = a Λ-like sign (slash and backslash), also in line 6 'dsen?e' where Kar. 103 has k in the same phrase. 'med': the d is a hook with a dash before it, could be t. Line 9 sign hatched (3-shaped). 'te(10)dḫlowi' has no e (only l). In 'psiste' the vowel is a 4 crossed by 3 (Kar. 103 has a plain slash, o, in the same word). Line 13: Griffith marks the te of 'ḫste' sic. In line 2 'mese(4)k' the se is U//.
check_notes: All entries placed. Name A skl : diyeqowi: the w-like sign with a tick is d+i touching, the Λ-like sign is y. B qow(?)oli: what I read s y is q + o; Griffith's ? on w kept (hatched). C mseye: the 2-shaped sign is m, the Λ-like sign y. mesen: long-tailed 3 is n. mnitowi: the 4-topped sign is i. medo: the dash before the hook is o. Formula C ḫmlo ẖlkte: Griffith reads the sic-marked /ϟ as lo.

caption: Kar. 106. Stela
notes: Different, larger hand (closer to Griffith's 'Inscr. 126' column): e is a 9-shape, l an s-shape. First group (line 1) is a 3 with two strokes, reading unclear (s y, or s o). The sign before line 2 is hatched on its left, a hooked sign with a long tail, read n?. Line 2 begins with four strokes (/ long + three short) read o? + y. First sign of line 2 continuation (row 2, far right) is a Σ-like sign with long tail, p or k. 'ℓ' in line 4 read d.
check_notes: All entries placed. First group is the title qo; name arotnyeqo (the four strokes are y, 9 is e, 7-shape + slash is q, slash o). pesetoleb yetmdelo(wi): copy has no -wi (Griffith supplies it in brackets); the s-shaped signs are e or l as the type gives.

caption: Kar. 107. Stela with traces of figures
reading: wisi : soreyi : beleki (2)kdi li qowi : kdis?rteli : (3)tedḫelowi : yetomẖe : pi(4)siẖte : atmẖe : pisiḫr
notes: Name: b then three S-shaped signs (e or l), then k (long-tailed 3) and i. Griffith marks sic over the sign read l? in 'kdisrl?li'. Line 7-ish group 'yetomẖe': before to stand an S and three strokes (///) where a (S2) is expected; read literally y e. 'p' written as a 4-topped long-tailed sign. 'psiḫr' ends the copy, no -kete. 'li' groups: small l (ϟ) then 4.
check_notes: All entries placed. Copy gaps inside the name kept (beleki kdi li qowi). B kdis(?)rteli: the sic-marked sign is te; Griffith's ? on s kept. Formulae: the 4 before the long-tailed p is i (pi-), not part of p; yeto confirmed.

caption: Kar. 108. Altar stela
reading: wosi : sori(2)yi : ḫpoyeqe(3)wi : wosmkse : te(4)dḫl?owi : soni : te(5)rikelowi : slẖs : (6)kditowi atomẖe pi(7)soẖte
notes: soreyi: the e is drawn like a 4. Name in line 2-3: ḫ (c-shape) with a long underline from the next sign (p or k); then four strokes read y; 'moe' could be 'mol'. Mother's line 'wosm?kse': 3 with short left tail (m or ẖ) then k with long tail, then se (V//). 'tedḫl?owi' has one S-like sign between ḫ and o. 'soki': the k is crossed by a slash. Line 6 group has no m: a long-tailed 3 (n?) and a 4-topped sign (p?) before to.
check_notes: All entries placed. soriyi: the 4-like sign after r is i. A ḫpoyeqewi (slash+3 is q). C soni: the long-tailed 3 crossed by a slash is n. slẖs kditowi: long-tailed 3 is k, 4+hook is di. pisoẖte: 4 before p is i.

caption: Kar. 109. Altar
reading: wosi : sore(2)i : b?ḫñ(3)y?iqowi : kdiye : ted(4)ḫelowi : mlobesr : teri(5)kelowi : tqi : mnito(6)wi : tete(7)r : mnpt (8)setelowi : (9)atomẖ p(10)soẖ at : mẖe : psi(11)ḫr : ḫmlol ẖol :
notes: Line 2: Griffith marks the e of soreyi sic; no y is written, only a 4 with an extra stroke (i, or y+i). Name: first sign is the to-sign (ب with dot) with a long tail; then ℓ (d), a crossed X with dot (ñ? or d); the 'y?' after l is two ticked strokes. 'mlobesr': the /ϟ after m read lo (could be te). Line 6 right group 'tm?i?i?': t then a 7-like 3 and two 4-like signs, unsure. Line 7: two slash-signs before r, the first /ϟ (te), the second /ϵ with a bar (te?). 'mnpt': m drawn as '2'. Line 9: Griffith marks sic over 'atomẖ', which lacks e; the (10) stands over the first s of 'p(10)sos'; that word has no te. Last row (no line number) has a hatched sign, read 'dl?lolsol'; the /ϟ pairs could be te.
check_notes: Entries placed except the alternative name bwdili (Griffith's 'or'), not adopted. Name A b(?)ḫñy(?)iqowi with Griffith's two ? kept. tqi: q is a 3 crossed by the slash, i follows. mnitowi: the double 4 is i. setelowi: the small w-sign is se. Formula C ḫmlol ẖol is the last row; the hatched sign is m.

caption: Kar. 110. Stela
reading: wis : soreyi : [.]di (2)beylowi : tqole : te(3)rikelowi : doki k(4)dise : tedḫelowi : (5)slẖ : mnptowi : tqe (6): mnitowi : atmẖe : (7)ato : mẖe : pisiẖ :
notes: Invocation written wos (no i). A small hatched mark stands at the divider after soreyi (not counted as a sign). Hatched block of about one sign before 'di' (kdi expected). 'beyl?owi': the sign before o is S-shaped (l or e). Line 2-3 group 'tm?yee?': last sign hatched, S-like. 'dosi': first pair is a slash and a hooked 2-shape (d+o, or te). Line 6 group 'tsoe?': t, 3, slash, hatched S-like sign. Left mnpḫwi group: p is a 4-topped sign. 'psim': p 4-topped, then 3, 4 (i or o), tailed 3 (m).
check_notes: All entries placed. Name A [k(?)]dibeylowi: k is lost in the copy's hatching, kept as [.]. B dokikdise, C tqole. Index A/B tqi for line 6 kept as tqe (Index C tqe; copy sign is S-like). In both mnptowi/mnitowi groups the copy's small c-shape is to as printed. pisiẖ: 4 before p is i. invocation wis confirmed.
